The '''Mission to Almas''' occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Following a [[Battle of Bespin (Imperial Period)|battle at Bespin]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denia]] sent an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team to the [[Almas Academy]] to acquire the [[Qornah Holocron]], which she believed could help her identify the species of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] she had seen on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The team landed on Almas and faced many hazards in the academy, including traps and Imperial forces. Eventually, they encountered [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]], whom they attacked and almost killed. The mission was a success, and they obtained the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].
